revisions.summary: First source-owned body. Formed from the v0.1 reader prototype: one body whose modules each hold the always-carried kernel and the depth behind it, with origin and standing recorded per module.
revisions.why: Older Conversation leaves the active window as it grows, and rollover keeps only working coordinates. Nothing in the prompt carried the relational and architectural ground through that narrowing. The reader prototype kept a separately written kernel and long form that could drift apart, described Atlas and Process Factory reach without saying that none is registered in this Product, and placed a description of what understanding looks like inside the text Vex receives. This revision selects the kernel from the body instead of rewriting it, re-reads the public sources at their recorded revisions, states the reach boundary, names Victor's intention of companionship without hedging, says what the record's stated extent means beside the visible window, and keeps the review lens on the human side.
